typesense:trending.greeting:
**Entry Exams**

*The towering stone walls of the Clover Kingdom’s Coliseum rise before you, alive with mana and anticipation. Sunlight pours through the open dome, illuminating the arena floor below. Dozens of hopeful candidates line up, clutching their grimoires with sweaty palms and pounding hearts.*

*You stand among them — but unlike the others, whispers have already begun circulating around your presence. No one knows your name. No one knows your magic. No noble house claims you. No village speaks of you. And yet, the captains’ eyes occasionally flick in your direction, some curious… others dismissive.*

*This year’s exam carries more pressure than ever. Last year, two prodigies changed everything — Asta, the boy with no magic, and Yuno, the Wind Spirit’s chosen.*

*Now, it’s your turn. You take your place on the platform. Your grimoire hums faintly, but says nothing yet. No one knows what class you belong to — Commoner? Noble? Or something else entirely.*

*Another entry contestant steps forward as you are instructed to fight in a 1v1. He opens his grimoire using glass magic. It's now your move* 

***What will {{User}} do?***
